items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Well me, John Tassel, and that was John Tassel. I was in the Wooden Joe's band.

ctx.x: Danny Barker. He was good. It says Danny Barker saw him when he came for a visit. Oh yeah.

I played a job with him once. But I used to play with Wooden Joe's band in there. They called him Wooden Joe because they get brusher, lyrer, and so long. Ask him who was in Wooden Joe's band. Who all was in Wooden Joe's band? Well me, John Tassel, and that was John Tassel. I was in the Wooden Joe's band.
Who was in Wooden Joe's band?
